_comment: Feature 0074 re-audit T2/#25: ONE token list for every boolean switch both runtimes read (VULTURE_USE_LLM above all). Go config.ParseFlag/EnvFlag and the agents' shared.env.env_flag / env_truthy (and every agent reader of VULTURE_USE_LLM: audit_runner, llm/mode.py, llm/health.py) must give each value its verdict: true and false are the flag's value, "default" means the value is not a token (blank, or unrecognised) and the caller's default applies. An unrecognised NON-BLANK value is also warned about once, naming the variable (`warns`). Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace ignored.
